searchText: This is a good feeback, is there anyone in the EF who can work on this as well or it's up to the community? I will ask around a bit but I don't think that there is more capacity. By ACDE of today we thus know EIP-836- is considered in next ACDE (in 2 weeks). The comments of above should be addressed and it would also be great to have the spec and some tests ready. Then the EIP is up-to-date and all comments are addressed.
